sanger_official_mask.description: Official Sanger MICRO21 low-bit dense PE / score-exp-sum architecture. UNSIGNED Q/K and approximate exp, NOT an exact signed-QKV softmax mask engine.
sanger_official_mask.compatibility: Chisel 3.4.1 upstream; scalar controls are explicit idle/clear/calc/move, not valid-ready. DensePE is unsigned. Original exp approximation is NOT the RQ1 exact EXP table; translate architecture only where semantics match. Also uses package exp_unit, conflicting with existing DynaX ExpUnitFixPoint if both compiled. Actual combined upstream elaboration under FAST Chisel 3.6.1 FAILED with legacy API syntax (e.g. asUInt()/andR()); immutable upstream is guidance only. Newly generated Chisel must use current API and exact task math.

flexcim_nm_distribution.description: Official FLOW/FlexCiM ISLPED25 N:M configurable two-stage data distribution mux; sparse operand routing reference.
flexcim_nm_distribution.compatibility: Flexible static weight sparsity routing, NOT dynamic attention pruning or top-n selection. Requires externally computed select indices; i_en is unused in source. Two-bit mux selectors limit native choices. Upstream Cocotb test parameters differ from defaults; inspect before adapting. Full FlexCiM sources are retained separately; this entry exposes only the distributor. This distributor passed 100 independent functional vectors. Full upstream FlexCiM bundle FAILED Verilator lint with syntax errors; do not assume its other modules are validated.

spatten_official_topk.description: Official MIT SpAtten hardware TopK and QuickSelect algorithms with streams, pivot selection, prefix sums and compaction. Use real TopK; TopKDummy is NOT a numerical implementation.
spatten_official_topk.compatibility: SpinalHDL Component, NOT Chisel Module: reference-only translation, cannot native-link in FAST Chisel. Do not copy simulator TopKDummy or precomputed latency model. Preserve task signed comparisons, exact cardinality and deterministic ties when adapting. Stream backpressure/variable latency differs from II=1 fixed-latency behavior contracts.

bitonic_sort_network.description: MIT-licensed parameterized signed/unsigned bitonic hardware sorting network; alternative blockwise ranking reference independent of streaming TopK.
bitonic_sort_network.compatibility: Sorts words only, no separate indices or mask. Power-of-two channel counts are the validated scope. Basic interface lacks reset/valid; adaptation needs explicit transaction alignment and reset masking. PIPE_REG=1 gives log2(N)*(log2(N)+1)/2 register layers; verify edge counting under any new wrapper. Native Verilog linking is not supported by current FAST Chisel backend. Independent 8-lane signed-9-bit probes passed 100 vectors each for combinational and fully pipelined configurations (6 edges).
